title: Abhi Maza Aayega Na Bidu
blurb: Now the fun begins, which is roughly what the line announces: a situation has just turned entertaining, almost always at somebody else's expense. Think of it as the desi internet's version of pulling up a chair and getting the popcorn out. The delivery carries genuine anticipation rather than malice, and that is what lets it land. Play it when drama ignites in the group chat, when a rematch is accepted, or when two people who dislike each other are seated at the same table. Abhi maza aayega na bidu.
origin: The viral 'now it gets fun' line from Indian meme culture.
